content.episode_sharpe: mean daily return / sample stdev daily return * sqrt(252); zero when fewer than 2 returns or stdev is zero
content.name: s5a_development_fitness_v1
content.performance_concentration: normalized HHI of absolute episode returns: (HHI - 1/N) / (1 - 1/N); zero when all returns are zero
content.return_dispersion: median absolute deviation of episode total returns
content.transaction_cost_rate: (commission_cents + slippage_cents) / starting capital; aggregate is median episode rate
content.turnover: episode traded notional / starting capital; aggregate is median episode turnover
